items.description: Fixed kitchen AC replacement, installation and delivery
items.rationale: The photo places the unit within five metres of the hob, so §2.3.10(c) excludes the surge damage absent a kitchen climate endorsement. Installation and delivery follow the excluded unit under §§7.1.11 and 9.5; the conditional estimate is for one like-for-like installed unit, since the claim documents only one damaged unit despite the invoice quantity of three.
